title: LET ANOTHER VIEW IN
goal: Break past rehearsal by separating the situation from self-judgment and allowing another view to enter.

steps.text: Name one brief holding cue.
Separate the situation from the self-judgment.
Name one visible change.
Complete the smallest next move.
Name one unfinished loop.

win: One visible change led to the smallest next move while the unfinished loop was named rather than reopened.
mindBend: Self-judgment makes a past event feel closed to new interpretation. Once identity is removed from the evidence, another view can actually fit.
formulaFlow: Make Cue → Unmix Story → Park Rest → Begin Now → Open Loop

title: LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN
goal: Stop fighting the thought and continue one small task without checking whether it left.

steps.text: Say, “This thought is allowed to be here for this minute.”
Notice one sound or object outside your head without using it to escape or prove anything.
Start one small task while letting the thought remain in the background.
Do not check whether the thought has faded before continuing.

win: The thought was allowed in the background while action continued without a disappearance check.
mindBend: Suppression gives a thought a monitoring job: keep searching for it to confirm it is gone. Permission ends that hidden task.
formulaFlow: Allow Thought → Notice Outside → Start Task → Skip Check
